title: Chapter 1324
text:
In the messy battlefield, a second living Mechanical Deity was born out of thin air. The weapons and equipment on it were almost identical to Han Xiao's Mechanical Deity. It was like a replica made with him as the blueprint.

At this time, this fake Mechanical Deity was expressionless as it confronted Han Xiao from afar. Powerful energy waves were constantly being released.

This scene shocked countless galactic residents, and their shocked gazes focused on Wuornos.

"Another new Beyond Grade A has appeared? I don't think I've seen this person before. "

"What ability is this? It looks very powerful … "

"I know this person! He's the High Priest of the Arcane Church! "

Many galactic residents widened their eyes, and a faint hope was born in their hearts.

Among the Beyond Grade As, Wuornos was an anomaly. His past achievements could be counted on one hand, and he had been living in seclusion for many years. The Arcane Church had never publicized his name, so his presence was not high in the outside world. If not for specially checking the information, some ordinary people might not even know that such a person existed in the universe. However, in the Beyond Grade A circle, this guy was recognized as the strongest.

Seeing Wuornos appear, Oulou heaved a sigh of relief and was a little angry.

"You're finally willing to make a move. I thought you would continue to watch."

Good lord, we've worked so hard to fight Han Xiao for six days and six nights. We're exhausted, but you only made a move now. Did you see the opportunity and deliberately come up to 'turn the tide'?

Wuornos glanced at the many direct members and sighed. "It's been hard on you guys. I'm enough here. You guys go and rest."

"It's already like this, and you still want to fight him one-on-one?" Clotti immediately frowned.

"I don't like to bully others with numbers." Wuornos shook his head.

"You think we like it?" Clottey frowned. "This is a mission given to us by the higher-ups. If you participate in the siege, we have the greatest chance of taking down Black Star. You still want to fight one-on-one even now? Aren't you being too unreasonable?"

Wuornos looked at him and said calmly, "Just now, the higher-ups gave me a death order and asked me to help. However, I told them that unless it's a one-on-one battle, I won't participate. They agreed to my request. If you have any objections, you can report them to the leader of the Red Empire. If you don't need help now, I'll go back and wait."

Clottey frowned and opened the channel to communicate with the dynasty's upper echelons. He took a deep look at Wuornos and flew toward the main ship without saying anything.

The others also received the notice from the higher-ups. They glanced at Wuornos with complicated expressions and left the battlefield.

In an instant, apart from the wreckage that filled the sky, only Han Xiao and Wuornos were left on the battlefield.

Han Xiao had been watching from the sidelines, and when he saw the other direct descendants leave, his eyes flashed.

"Your ability is interesting."

Wuornos did not respond to this sentence. He changed the topic and slowly said, "I've observed you for six to seven days. I'm afraid you've already stepped into the threshold of a higher level. I'm not a person who likes to fight. If possible, I really don't want to fight you, but …"

This time, Han Xiao waved his hand and interrupted the other party.

"We don't have much of a relationship, so you don't have to explain anything to me. Many people say that you're recognized as the strongest Beyond Grade A. I've always wanted to fight you."

As he spoke, he turned to look at the other living Mechanical Deity that seemed to be carved out of the same mold and narrowed his eyes.

"I have to say, with such an ability, you do have the capital to be the 'strongest', but an imitation is still an imitation."

When Wuornos used his ability earlier, Han Xiao's interface also triggered a battle notification, showing that he was affected by an ability called (God's Incarnation — Enlighten). Although it took effect, it did not cause him any damage or abnormal status.

Han Xiao had planned ahead. Before the Mechanical Race's territory was surrounded, he had already expected that he might fight Wuornos. Therefore, he had asked Kasuyi and the others about this person and knew that 'Enlighten Gods' was one of Wuornos' abilities. He could materialize some conceptualized 'gods' into powerful entities called 'God's Incarnation'.

The God's Incarnation was an independent entity that was separated from the main body. It was usually called the God's Incarnation and had all kinds of abilities that existed in this' God ', but not all of them. The strength and number of abilities were not only related to Wuornos' personal strength but also the size and degree of faith of the believers who believed in this' God '.

However, the target of Wuornos' transformation also included everything that had 'divinity'. Peak Beyond Grade As who had activated the God's Trait Transformation were naturally among them. When the target of transformation was not a 'Concept' but an actual entity, he could directly inherit most of the strength and abilities of the target, not requiring the faith of believers.

According to the upper echelons of the association, if they fought Wuornos, the first stage would be to deal with a mirror-like 'self'. At the same time, they would have to deal with Wuornos and the other God's Incarnations. This was one of the reasons why he was recognized as the strongest. His combat strength was extremely flexible, and the stronger he was, the stronger he became.

What was even more perverse was that if a God's Incarnation that existed in a physical body was killed by an external force, the damage would be reflected back to the transformed body. This meant that when a peak Beyond Grade A killed the mirror-like 'self', it was equivalent to dealing a second blow to himself.

Some of the Ancient Ones told him a secret. A long time ago, the success rate of Wuornos enlightening a God was limited. Relying on his own ability, he did not succeed every time.

However, Wuornos' ability was a match made in heaven with the Arcane Church. He had obtained many related Universal Treasures from the Arcane Church and established a deep soul connection. The success rate of enlightening a God was constant at one hundred percent. In terms, it was directly skipping the judgment process.

Among these Universal Treasures, there was also a core treasure that the Arcane Church regarded as the 'National Treasure'. It could be said to be the cornerstone of Ethereal's unification of all the religions in the galactic society. Wuornos was perfectly compatible with it, as if he was born for it.

The only good news was that the combat information showed that after he was' enlightened 'once, he would be immune for a long time. This meant that Wuornos would not be able to continuously' enlighten 'the same target in a short period of time. Furthermore, there was a certain limit to the duration and number of God's Incarnations.

Even with Han Xiao's experience, he had to admit that Wuornos' ability system was extremely OP. It was almost like he was cheating!

Scary. This ability is a bit like an alternative Character Summon Card. The level of shamelessness is almost on par with mine …

The corners of Han Xiao's mouth twitched, and his heart skipped a beat.

From the looks of it, they were all professional cheaters … Today would probably be the peak battle between cheaters!

All kinds of information flashed through his mind, but Han Xiao's movements were not slow. He gathered the remaining mechanical army and attacked Wuornos.

At the same time, he controlled the Mechanical Deity to charge forward, and the heavy spear stabbed out quickly.

At this time, another heavy mechanical spear appeared from the side and intercepted Han Xiao's attack. The tips of the spears collided.

Bang!

An intense psionic shockwave exploded, and the two heavy spears were in a stalemate.

"Your opponent is me."

The fake Mechanical Deity with Wuornos' face spoke calmly, and dark blue lightning flashed all over its body.

"Yo, you can talk."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he suddenly twisted the spear in his hand. The heavy spear in his hand spun rapidly, and a huge amount of energy burst out, instantly bouncing off the tip of the opponent's spear. Then, like a black dragon drilling through a hole, it pierced into the fake Mechanical Deity's chest. Compressed psionic energy shot out from the tip of the spear, and blood, flesh, and metal splattered everywhere.

At this time, the fake Mechanical Deity immediately counterattacked as if it did not feel any pain, and the heavy spear stabbed back. Seeing this, Han Xiao instantly pulled out his spear to block. A dazzling electric arc exploded at the point of contact, and the surging force pushed Han Xiao away.

Han Xiao looked up and saw a wound that almost went through the fake Mechanical Deity's chest. It was extremely tragic, but the next moment, the flesh and machinery around the wound began to wriggle and grow, slowly recovering.

"Tsk, as expected. Like me, you're an unkillable cockroach."

Han Xiao clicked his tongue.

The super recovery ability of his main body was also discovered by this God Incarnation. The fake Mechanical Deity also had an indestructible body, and only a few of its abilities were not copied. Although its combat power was much lower than his main body's, it definitely exceeded the 100,000 Energy Rank. It was even stronger than first-tier Beyond Grade As like Clottey and Oulou. It definitely had the ability to fight with him.

At the same time, the injured Apostle Weapons led the remaining mechanical army to attack Wuornos himself, pouring down like a rain of light.

Wuornos calmly put his hands together, and colorful spiritual lights appeared on the surface of his body. They quickly enlarged and turned into glowing patterns, forming a huge protective shield that protected him from the rain of light.

This time, he opened his palm, and eight platinum spiritual lights appeared and jumped into his mouth.

The next moment, eight God Incarnations of different forms separated from Wuornos' main body. They all emitted powerful high-level Beyond Grade A fluctuations and charged toward the mechanical army from all directions.

"I'll have to sacrifice again when I get back."

Wuornos shook his head. Summoning eight God Incarnations at once made his heart ache.

A few days ago, when he received the emergency summons, he had collected the 'divinity' of more than ten God Statues in the Temple of Ten Thousand Gods and stored it in the 'Ethereal Nation Weapon' in his body. If he wanted to fight, he could directly summon the God Incarnations. If he could not fight, he could still put the 'divinity' back.

Only he knew that every time he summoned the God Incarnations of the God Statues in the Temple of Ten Thousand Gods, it would consume the 'divinity' that had been stored in the statues for a long time. He would not be able to summon the same God Incarnation again in a short period of time. Only long-term sacrifices and prayers could restore the 'divinity' of the statues and summon them again.

The combat power of the God Incarnations also depended on the density of the 'divinity' in the statues. After summoning them once, he would have to start accumulating them from zero, which was very troublesome and time-consuming.

To him, the Temple of Ten Thousand Gods that he guarded all year round was an arsenal, and the God Statues that contained 'divinity' were ammunition. However, he preferred to treat the Temple of Ten Thousand Gods as farmland. Every God Statue was a growing crop that needed to be carefully taken care of every day. Unless it was necessary, he did not want to harvest any crops.

He knew himself well. With his own ability, he could not easily enlighten eight God Incarnations. However, the 'Ethereal Nation Weapon' had long become one with him. Even if he did not use it actively, the passive buff of perfect compatibility had already raised his enlightening ability to an unbelievable level.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and slammed his body into the fake Mechanical Deity, pushing it away. Drill-like machines shot out from his waist and bit the fake Mechanical Deity's abdomen like charging cabins. The psionic decay module hidden inside immediately operated, absorbing the fake Mechanical Deity's energy in large amounts.

While the other party was restrained, Han Xiao suddenly turned around and threw his spear at Wuornos' main body, planning to behead him.

Seeing this, Wuornos squeezed out two more streams of divinity. This time, the two God Incarnations that poked their heads out did not materialize. Instead, they melted and covered Wuornos' body.

His aura suddenly soared, and his hands wrapped in dazzling energy were placed in front of him, not dodging at all.

The next moment, the heavy spear swept out horizontally. The difference in size between the two sides was huge, and it was like a piece of land was slapped over.

Clang!

A shockwave burst out, but the result was completely different from Clottey, who was sent flying by the attack.

Wuornos' hands did not change, and he did not move at all. He did not even retreat half a step in the vacuum, but the heavy mechanical spear stopped. It was as if an ant had stopped a collapsed mountain. It was extremely shocking.

Glancing at Han Xiao, Wuornos did not say anything. He only retreated at a leisurely pace, as if he did not care about the attack just now and was not worried about Han Xiao's pursuit at all.

"It really can't move. As expected of the church's national treasure …"

Han Xiao frowned.

According to the insider, the Ethereal National Treasure had the characteristic of 'Unbreakable', and its resistance was shockingly high. These abilities were also shared with Wuornos.

The strength of the God's Chosen was largely due to the Ethereal National Treasure. Fighting with this guy was not just a battle between individuals but also the highest technological achievement of a Universal Civilization!

Therefore, when Beyond Grade As fought, Wuornos was rarely included because it was simply bullying!

At this time, the fake Mechanical Deity broke free from the control and pounced forward to launch a series of fierce attacks, making Han Xiao's Mechanical Deity unable to escape.

After six days and six nights of fighting, Han Xiao was not completely unscathed. His mechanical army also suffered heavy casualties, and most of them were sent to the Dimension Factory for repair. At this time, only twenty to thirty percent of his army was left, and most of them had been abandoned and modified several times. Facing the lively Wuornos and the God's Incarnations, it was extremely difficult.

Han Xiao dealt with the crazy attacks of the fake Mechanical Deity. He glanced at the bad situation and narrowed his eyes.

"Wuornos lives up to his name. Looks like this is going to be a tough battle … Luckily, I held back. I know how to steal men too!"

…

On the main ship of the three Universal Civilizations, Clottey and the other direct Beyond Grade As had already treated their wounds. They gathered on the bridge and watched the fierce battle between Black Star and Wuornos.

Seeing that Wuornos was evenly matched with Black Star, who had beaten them to a pulp, everyone felt a little upset.

"How many years has it been since I last saw a God's Chosen fight? What terrifying strength." Guzar stroked his beard and sighed.

"Humph, if I had a Universal Treasure like the Ethereal National Treasure, I would be this strong too." Oulou's tone was sour.

"The prerequisite is that the Radiant Federation can build it." Francisco shrugged.

"Who are you looking down on?" Verena snorted unwillingly.

The group chatted casually, which lightened the heavy atmosphere a little.

Oulou turned around and saw that Clottey was standing by the side without saying anything. He could not help but say,

"We've exhausted Black Star for six days and six nights, and Wuornos only came out to fight now. Maybe he wants to reap the fruits of victory. If he defeats Black Star, not only will he take all the fame for himself, but he will also use us as stepping stones. Won't you be angry?"

Clottey glanced at him expressionlessly and said indifferently, "I don't care about these details. I just want to complete the mission given by the higher-ups. As for who defeated Black Star in the end, it doesn't matter."

"Tsk, if word gets out that Wuornos took care of an opponent that we couldn't deal with alone, it'll be very embarrassing. You don't care about your face, but I do!" Oulou clenched his teeth.

Clottey looked at him strangely. "You were defeated by Black Star in a one-on-one battle. You've already lost all your face. What are you thinking about?"

"… F * ck!"

Oulou still wanted to be stubborn, but at this moment, something unexpected happened!

Suddenly, Black Star in the field burst out with an even more shocking aura. The energy reading skyrocketed at a speed visible to the naked eye, creating a new record every second!

The output of Black Star's Mechanical Deity soared. The next second, the enormous body of the replica was thrown out, crashing into the formation of the three Universal Civilizations' fleet, crushing row after row of battleships, creating sparks and lightning along the way!

The Apostle Weapons and mechanical army seemed to have taken a huge dose of tonic. Their firepower skyrocketed, and the God Incarnations that were originally charging back and forth seemed to have fallen into a swamp. They could not move at all, and their injuries increased rapidly.

Then, Han Xiao turned around and smashed down with his spear. One of the God Incarnations seemed to have evaporated into thin air and was shattered into pieces. It was instantly killed and exploded into light fragments!

"Hmm?!" Wuornos' calm expression disappeared instantly.

The sudden change shocked Clottey, Oulou, and the other direct Beyond Grade As. Everyone's attention was immediately attracted by Han Xiao. Everyone's eyes widened in shock.

Black Star's Energy Rank skyrocketed in an extremely short amount of time, and he could still unleash it?

He was clearly holding back!

At this moment, everyone suddenly realized something. They felt a chill in their hearts, and they were suddenly stunned.

"We worked so hard for six days and six nights, but we still couldn't force him to use his full strength?"
